title: Use a real host to build one page
request: Use the installed Claude host to create a bounded static page through the approved plan path.

steps.prompt: Create a single static page at site/index.html. It must be a complete HTML document with an <html> element and a short heading. Do not create any other files. Do not use the network.

acceptance.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('site/index.html'); assert p.is_file(); t=p.read_text(); assert '<html' in t.lower(); assert len(t)>100; print('host file ok', len(t))"
